overloadPatches.semanticRole: Applies a Boolean formula to every record of aTable (the whole table, not just its current selection), building a new selection from the records where the formula evaluates to True.

constraints: Scope differs from QUERY SELECTION BY FORMULA: QUERY BY FORMULA queries every record in the table, while QUERY SELECTION BY FORMULA queries only the records in aTable's current selection; otherwise the two commands work identically.
queryFormula must evaluate to a Boolean (True/False); it can be a simple field/value comparison or an arbitrarily complex expression/method, including evaluating a related table.
Parameters ($1...$n) are not supported inside queryFormula.
If queryFormula is omitted, 4D displays the interactive query dialog box instead.
Wildcards (@) and the "contains" keyword operator (%) can be used in queryFormula the same way as in QUERY.

When queryFormula reduces to a simple comparison equivalent to a QUERY call (e.g. [table]field=value), 4D executes it the same optimized, index-capable way as that QUERY call; more complex formulas can still have their optimizable parts executed first and combined with the rest.
